caption: The drawing contains a vertical strip in the center of the page, bordered by faint parallel pencil lines. Within this strip, a single, thin, winding black stem extends from the bottom to the top. Attached to the stem at intervals are seven dark green leaves, alternately positioned on opposite sides of the stem. Interspersed along the stem are also seven flower buds, each consisting of a black base and a pointed, petal-like top section colored in shades of orange and accented with fine lines. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or designs outside the central floral motif. In the upper left corner of the paper, there is a small circle containing the number “1.”
title: Silk Applique Quilt
